title: verbascum portae
intro: Verbascum portae, commonly known as the Porta mullein or Verbascum virgatum, is a flowering plant in the figwort family that is native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and insomnia, and soothing respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum portae are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, iridoid glycosides, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of this plant are primarily due to its ability to modulate the immune system, calm the nervous system, and protect against oxidative stress.
